questions.question: What makes Jasmine different from other marketing agencies?

questions.answer: Yes. We offer flexible event coverage that can be added to any existing plan. Whether it’s a product launch, auto show, or grand opening, we deliver premium cinematic content tailored specifically to each event.
questions.question: Can you handle marketing for events outside of the monthly packages?

questions.answer: We offer both structured monthly partnerships and per-project solutions. Our packages are designed to scale with your business, from emerging dealerships to enterprise-level automotive brands.
questions.question: Does Jasmine have specific packages, or do you work per project?

questions.answer: Jasmine operates globally, with a strong focus on the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and the wider Middle East. We are also able to travel for productions and manage remote campaigns worldwide.
questions.question: Where can Jasmine work?

jobs.title: Junior Business Assistant
jobs.summary:
About the job

About Jasmine
Jasmine Iraq is a leading provider of digital marketing solutions, specializing in strategic branding, creative content production, social media management, and event coordination. With expertise in both local and global trends, the company delivers tailored strategies to enhance brand awareness and promote business growth. Known for innovation and excellence, Jasmine Iraq creates impactful campaigns to address complex business challenges with creativity and precision. The company proudly serves as a trusted partner for businesses across Iraq, driving digital transformation and delivering results with a client-focused approach.

Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role based in Sulaymaniyah. As a Junior Business Assistant, you will provide essential administrative and day-to-day support to the management and operations teams. Day-to-day tasks include assisting with scheduling, organizing files and documents, basic data entry, preparing meeting materials, and helping with internal communications. You will have the opportunity to learn standard business operations, support project tracking, and contribute to a smooth-running office environment while developing your professional skills.

Qualifications
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Basic proficiency in office software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace).
Good written and verbal communication skills.
A proactive attitude, eagerness to learn, and strong attention to detail.
Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment and follow instructions accurately.
Previous internship or entry-level administrative experience is a plus but not required.
An interest in digital marketing, communications, or business administration.

Note: Applications without a CV will be discarded.

jobs.title: Automotive Videographer/Photographer
jobs.summary:
Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role based in Sulaymaniyah. As an Automotive Videographer/Photographer, you will be responsible for capturing high-quality, dynamic visual content of vehicles for a range of digital campaigns, social media platforms, and brand assets. Day-to-day tasks include planning shoots, operating professional camera and lighting equipment, filming and photographing automotive subjects, and editing the final content. You will collaborate closely with the marketing and creative teams to deliver visually striking content that highlights automotive features, aligns with client objectives, and elevates their brand presence.

Qualifications
Strong skills in both photography and videography, with a specific focus on or passion for the automotive industry.
Proficiency in operating professional camera equipment, lenses, lighting, and stabilization gear (such as gimbals).
Proficiency in photo and video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Photoshop, and After Effects.
A strong eye for automotive angles, lighting, composition, and capturing vehicles in motion.
Attention to detail, creativity, and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with drone operation and aerial videography is a strong plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team.
You must provide a Portfolio or Showreel showcasing your videography and photography work (automotive work preferred).

Note: Applications without a Portfolio/Showreel and Cover Letter will be discarded.

Send your CV & Portfolio/Showreel to info@Jasmine.krd

jobs.title: Copywriter / Content Strategist
jobs.summary:
Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role based in Sulaymaniyah. As a Copywriter / Content Strategist, you will be responsible for crafting compelling, clear, and engaging written content across various digital and traditional platforms. Day-to-day tasks include writing social media captions, video scripts, ad copy, and branding materials, as well as collaborating with the design and video teams to ensure visuals and text work seamlessly together. You will develop content strategies that align with client objectives, capture their unique brand voice, and drive audience engagement.

Qualifications
Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills in both Kurdish and Arabic (English is a strong plus).
Proven experience in copywriting, content creation, or digital marketing.
Ability to adapt tone and style to suit different brands and target audiences.
A solid understanding of social media trends, digital advertising, and basic SEO principles.
Strong attention to detail, creativity, and the ability to meet deadlines.
Ability to work collaboratively with designers, videographers, and account managers.
You must provide a Portfolio showcasing your writing samples or past campaigns.

Note: Applications without a Portfolio will be discarded.

Send your CV & Portfolio to info@Jasmine.krd

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.summary:
Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role based in Sulaymaniyah. As an Account Manager, you will act as the primary bridge between our clients and the internal creative team. Day-to-day tasks include onboarding new clients, gathering project briefs, managing timelines, presenting finalized campaigns, and ensuring client expectations are consistently met or exceeded. You will build strong, long-lasting relationships, ensure smooth project delivery, and proactively identify new opportunities to help clients grow their businesses through our services.

Qualifications
Proven experience in account management, client success, or project management, preferably within a marketing or creative agency.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective client and internal team collaboration.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts and projects simultaneously.
A solid understanding of digital marketing, branding, and content production processes.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a customer-oriented approach.
Ability to present ideas confidently and negotiate when necessary.

Note: Applications without a CV will be discarded.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.summary:
Role Description
This is a full-time on-site role based in Sulaymaniyah. As an Event Coordinator, you will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing high-impact events for both Jasmine Iraq and our clients. Day-to-day tasks include scouting locations, managing vendor relationships, coordinating logistics, handling event budgets, and overseeing on-site execution to ensure everything runs flawlessly. You will collaborate with the marketing team to ensure each event aligns with the broader branding strategy and leaves a lasting, positive impression on attendees.

Qualifications
Proven experience in event planning, coordination, or a similar organizational role.
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure.
Strong communication and negotiation skills for dealing with vendors, sponsors, and clients.
A keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Ability to manage budgets effectively and track event expenses.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings or weekends, during active event execution.
A background in marketing or public relations is a plus.

Note: Applications without a CV will be discarded.

jobs.title: Copywriter/Content Writer
jobs.summary:
Are you a storyteller who knows how to capture an audience's attention?
We are looking for a creative, adaptable, and results-driven writer to join our growing team. In this role, you will be the voice of our brand, crafting compelling narratives that engage our community and drive our business forward. If you love playing with words and understanding the psychology behind a great campaign, we want you here!

What You Will Do
Write, edit, and publish engaging, high-quality content for our website, blogs, and social media platforms.

Develop compelling ad copy, email campaigns, and landing page materials to drive user conversions.

Collaborate with the marketing and design teams to ensure brand voice consistency across all channels.

Conduct keyword research and apply SEO best practices to increase our organic online visibility.

What We Are Looking For
Proven experience working as a Copywriter, Content Writer, or in a similar creative role.

Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a meticulous eye for detail.

Solid understanding of digital marketing campaigns, SEO principles, and modern content strategy.

Ability to seamlessly adapt your writing style and tone to suit different audiences, formats, and platforms.
